content.scenario: The Central Authority or any officer authorised by it must file a complaint for any offence under sections 88 and 89.
content.outcome: No cognizance shall be taken by a competent court of any offence under sections 88 and 89 except on a complaint filed by the Central Authority or any officer authorised by it in this behalf.

user_queries: What is the process for filing a complaint?
What are the requirements for filing a complaint?
